items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: I can remember hearing Bergen say that among many other people.

ctx.x: Yeah I've, I've always been conscious of intonation. Probably, in fact I've probably been too conscious of it and it's always bothered me. Yeah. That's always been uppermost in my mind. Just being in tune.
You never felt good enough for jazz? No. I can remember hearing Bergen say that among many other people.
When it's good enough for jazz it should be in tune.
